doc.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Touring and the Vanguard with the new trio
summary: The album led to European tours and extended Village Vanguard engagements arranged with Max Gordon.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: What were you looking for when you select—well I’ll ask you that a little bit later. So for your first recording as a leader, your own band, a band that you put together, was this album helpful in securing work for that band
Oh yeah. We went on a lot of tours in Europe, all over the place.
With this group? Three months? What were the dates that he was at the Vanguard with this group?
From March to May of ’68? So as soon as this recording was finished?
Cause Max was, we could go into the Village Vanguard anytime we wanted to/.
Max Gordon, you were talking about Max Gordon.
Yeah that was a successful trio there. Yeah I still don’t know what its all about. I could never figure out billboard. (Laughs)
